name: Mercedes S-Class
basedOn: Mercedes-Benz S-Class long wheelbase W223 (V223), S 580 4MATIC, US model year 2027
sources: Mercedes-Benz USA, 2027 S-Class quick reference guide: length 208.8 in, width 75.6 in (83.6 in with mirrors), wheelbase 126.6 in; turning circle 39.0 ft with 4.5° rear-axle steering (standard) and 35.4 ft with 10° (optional), wall to wall. https://media.mbusa.com/news/2027-mercedes-benz-s-class-quick-reference-guide

Mercedes-Benz USA, 2022 S-Class quick reference guide: height 59.2 in; the 10° rear-axle steering cuts the circle by up to 7 ft. https://web.archive.org/web/2022/https://media.mbusa.com/releases/release-7122b266eca9fbce132ea26634041549-2022-mercedes-benz-s-class-sedan-quick-reference-guide
Spec databases (auto-data.net, cars-data.com) for the 2021-2025 car: track 1.655 m front, 1.683 m rear; overhangs 0.877 m front, 1.196 m rear
notes: Rear-axle frame: x forward from the rear axle, z to the right, metres. Only wall-to-wall circles are published, so the front wheels' lock is the one angle that fits both (37.2°); it gives 11.85 m and 10.85 m against the published 11.89 and 10.79 m, and about 12.85 m with the rear steering off (Mercedes says up to 7 ft more than with 10°). At parking speed the rear wheels turn the other way to the front, in proportion: the car then turns about a point ahead of the rear axle. The 2022 guide gives a 5.289 m length and 1.954 m width; this file uses the 2027 guide's, the same guide as the turning circles. One track for all four wheels: the front one.
estimates: the front overhang: 5.304 m - 3.216 m - 1.196 m = 0.892 m (the facelift's extra 15 mm put at the front)
